title: Semantic Room/Container Reconciliation
findings: 47 room polygons are present in the F3-reconciled candidate.
Named polygons are treated as presentation-room candidates, not automatically as route nodes.
Unnamed polygons are conservatively retained as container/circulation candidates unless stronger evidence exists.
Invisible polygons are retained as structural/hidden evidence and excluded from route-node promotion.
Three strong polygon containment/overlap relationships were detected; these reinforce that polygon count must not be equated with physical room count.
No room polygon was deleted or modified.
No physical door was promoted to a validated endpoint pair.
No route was validated or implemented.
next_gate: Physical door endpoint binding against semantically eligible named/circulation spaces, using wall evidence and existing navigation contracts.
